## How it was tested
- [ ] `pytest`, `ruff check .`, `mypy`
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`
- [ ] If the decision model, a policy, a scenario, or the simulator changed: `python scripts/check_reproducibility.py` and, if hashes changed on purpose, updated reference results and explained why below

## Research integrity
- [ ] No result is presented as a human-study result unless it comes from a human study
- [ ] Simulated results are labelled as simulated
- [ ] No questionnaire text was added without checking its licence
